texts.facts: The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, claiming compensation of Rs.25,00,000/- for the accidental injuries sustained by him in a road traffic accident took place on 12.04.2023. Hence, the respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation to the petitioner.
